title: Dynamics of simply parabolic inner functions
summary: We study the dynamics of Polya-Szegö inner functions and discuss some of their basic properties such as equivalent conditions for simple and double parabolicity. We show that a simply parabolic Polya-Szegö inner function admits forward and backward quotient half-cylinders, which allows one to enrich its dynamics with a Lavaurs map. To proceed, we restrict our attention to simply parabolic inner functions with finite Lyapunov exponent: $\int_{\mathbb{R}} \log |F'| d\ell < \infty$.
